name: Liu Chan Yang Cheng Ji Hua
source: After Liu Bei's passing, as Zhuge Liang, the Chancellor of Shu Han, not only do I aim to fulfill Liu Bei's wish for a peaceful empire, but I must also nurture Liu Bei's daughter, Liu Shan, entrusted to me as an orphan, to become an adept Empress of Shu Han...
translation: 刘备去世后，我身为蜀汉相国诸葛亮，不但要完成刘备天下太平的心愿，还要将刘备托付给我的女儿刘禅，培养成为一名得力的蜀汉皇后……
